snippet.title: Raiders Sphere 4th Promotion Video
snippet.description:
This is a doujin (indie) game from a circle named Rectangle, it is an Ace Combat like arcade flight combat simulator. In the distant future, humanity has turned Venus into a livable environment. However, not all is well on Venusian soil as political intrigue pushes the way to help a young girl, the ace pilot known as Sonic Venus, find the whereabouts of her missing father. Take to the skies of the second planet of the sun in this thrilling Ace Combat-like indie game, where you will find much more than just the story of one family's heritage, but also something that will change the planet entirely.

Development of the game is done and we've been localizing it and will be done in the next few weeks. The game also supports Oculus Rift and other 3d displays.

Please vote for us on Greenlight: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=346410651
